last_session.text: The party reached Brandonsford at sunset, following a treasure map to places they did not recognize.
Reginald the frog warned Dr. Uriah that a trickster Clurichen comes from the riverbanks every night.
Dunk spent the night drinking with Farmer Gill, who told how Sir Brandon slew a dragon centuries ago.
Eric the Reeve offered a bounty for the dragon. Sir Phidipaldi then slapped him and challenged him to a duel.
Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp, offered to hire on with Dr. Uriah, who said he would think about it.
Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn of the Golden Egg catch whoever empties his ale each night.

open.text: Find the treasure shown on the party's map.
Kill the black dragon and drag its body into town to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Catch whoever empties Quinn's good ale each night and collect his 100 gold.
If the party pays Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter, she will join them to hunt the dragon. She won't go alone.
If Dr. Uriah pays Drop Dead Ned 100 gold a week, Ned and his killer wasp will work for him. Ned insists on killing people with the wasp.
If Sir Phidipaldi stages the fake delivery of water-filled bottles, the party may see who comes for Quinn's ale.
Where are the map's marked locations, and which one holds the treasure?
Who or what empties Quinn's good ale each night?
Where does the black dragon lurk outside Brandonsford?
What happened to Bentley's overdue shipment, and why has nothing reached Brandonsford in months?
Where did the new dragon come from?
The black dragon tore off George's arm and may maim or kill others, including Gill's three sons hunting it.
